# Top-level help, version, errors, and command help are available without a board.
exec tuck$exe
stdout 'tuck — deterministic product-board operations'
! stderr .+

exec tuck$exe -h
stdout 'Usage:'
exec tuck$exe --help
stdout 'Maintain:'
exec tuck$exe help
stdout 'Use "tuck <command> --help"'

exec tuck$exe version
stdout 'tuck dev'
exec tuck$exe --version
stdout 'tuck dev'

! exec tuck$exe unknown-command
stderr 'tuck: unknown command "unknown-command"'
! stdout .+

! exec tuck$exe --root
stderr 'tuck: --root requires a path and command'
! exec tuck$exe --root=somewhere
stderr 'tuck: --root requires a command'
! exec tuck$exe init --root
stderr 'tuck init: --root requires a path'
! exec tuck$exe init --root=
stderr 'tuck init: --root requires a path'

exec tuck$exe list --help
stdout 'List tasks in board order'
exec tuck$exe add -h
stdout 'Create a task with a stable number and ID'
exec tuck$exe find --help
stdout 'Find task candidates'
exec tuck$exe meta --help
stdout 'Read or change flat user-defined task metadata'
